answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake tied to hardware attestation: a TPM-bound key proves one agent per physical device, like copper wiring fixed to a single board, or pigment bound to one canvas. New identities start with near-zero trust and must earn reputation slowly, the way a willow grows — an attacker cloning thousands of identities pays the full hardware and time cost for each, while honest agents amortize one stake across many useful transactions.
